_comment: SERVER computer only. Copy this file to 'server-config.json' (next to LOS-LMS.exe) and fill in the tunnel token. That publishes THIS machine at the fixed HostedUrl so remote staff reach it at a permanent address. Without a token, the server still works for anyone on the local network. The optional BackupFtp* fields, when set, upload each nightly database backup offsite (e.g. your Hostinger FTP); leave them blank to keep backups local only.
